assets.title: Paper

assets.title: Ball Paper #4
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Short transient can establish the material. Do not play it while a static texture sits still.

assets.title: Road map #10
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: A larger rustle supports a large sheet. Trim before it becomes busy.

assets.title: Pages that Turn #5
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Small-scale material cue is preferable to a trailer-style whoosh.

assets.title: Pencil #4
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN & Axeline T.
assets.note: Gate to visible strokes and leave pen-lift gaps. Avoid making each letter an identical click.

assets.title: Pencil, signature #2
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN & Axeline T.
assets.note: Reserve a phrase for a short label or flourish, aligned to its real stroke.

assets.title: Felt coloring
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Keep sustained texture beneath the main event. Choose clean sections after listening.

assets.title: Teaspoon, handled on a plate
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: A brief real contact grounds the spoon before the abstract camera move. Avoid repeated clatter.

assets.title: Teaspoon, placed on table
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Select one small contact rather than a whole handling passage.

assets.title: Aluminum pan bottom 26cm
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: A struck pan may ring brightly. Trim or damp it after audition; do not imply it is a cast-iron setdown.

assets.title: Frying pan #3
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Use heat texture only if heat is part of the depicted action. Fade it away before a dry diagram reveal.

assets.title: Whoosh #4
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Quiet movement support. Place the energy at acceleration and leave sustained drifting camera moves silent.

assets.title: Whoosh #6
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Material-derived air motion can connect the real pan with a crafted diagram without a loud impact.

assets.title: Whoosh #10
assets.creator: Joseph SARDIN
assets.note: Keep as an alternate, not an extra layer on every move. Confirm stereo motion does not fight the image.
